title: Center a Card
question: Edit styles.css so the .card is perfectly centered (horizontally AND vertically) inside .stage using flexbox.
hints: display: flex turns .stage into a flex container.
justify-content: center centers horizontally; align-items: center centers vertically.
bruteForce: Absolute positioning + transform also works but flexbox is cleaner here.

discussion.whyAsked: The most common CSS interview task.
followUps: How would you center with Grid?

title: Three-Column Grid
question: Edit styles.css so .grid lays its items out in 3 equal-width columns with a 12px gap.
exampleOutput: Two rows of three equal columns.
hints: grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) makes three equal tracks.
bruteForce: Flexbox with flex-basis: 33% works but Grid is cleaner for a true grid.

discussion.mistakes: Forgetting display:grid; using percentages that ignore the gap.
followUps: Make it responsive with auto-fit + minmax.

title: Truncate with Ellipsis
question: Edit styles.css so the long .title text is cut off with an ellipsis (…) on a single line.

files.index.html: This is a very long title that should be truncated with an ellipsis instead of wrapping

constraints: All three properties are required for single-line truncation.
hints: white-space: nowrap keeps it on one line.
overflow: hidden clips it; text-overflow: ellipsis adds the …
bruteForce: JS truncation is unnecessary; CSS handles it.
optimized: The three-property combo; for multi-line use -webkit-line-clamp.

discussion.mistakes: Forgetting any one of the three properties.
followUps: How do you clamp to 2 lines?

title: Build a Navbar
question: Edit styles.css so .nav puts the logo on the left and the links on the right, vertically centered, using flexbox.
exampleOutput: Brand left, links right, centered vertically.
hints: display: flex + justify-content: space-between pushes the two groups apart.
bruteForce: Floats are the legacy approach; flexbox is the modern one.

followUps: How would you make it stack on mobile?

title: Style a Button with Hover
question: Edit styles.css to give .btn a blue background, white text, padding, rounded corners, a pointer cursor, and a darker background on :hover with a smooth transition.
exampleOutput: A blue button that darkens smoothly on hover.
constraints: Include a :hover state and a transition.
hints: transition: background 0.2s ease animates the color change.
optimized: transition on the base rule, color change on :hover.

discussion.mistakes: Putting the transition on :hover instead of the base selector.
followUps: Why put the transition on the base rule, not :hover?
